description: POOPy is a Python client for event-duration monitoring feeds from English and Welsh water companies. Its README explains how the package collects live combined sewer overflow states for a map application and can be used to explore discharges to rivers. Users select water-company feeds or monitored outfalls; outputs are structured spill event information for the available locations. Geographic coverage follows companies that publish compatible EDM data in England and Wales. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing for the client. A limitation is that active EDM signals indicate a possible discharge, not its volume, pollutant load or exposure at a downstream intake. Company data completeness and update latency vary. POOPy can prepare wastewater-event inputs for river-quality or service-disruption simulations. The related catalogue EPANET model addresses drinking-water distribution and does not include these overflow feeds. No live event data or package was downloaded.
name: POOPy event-duration monitoring client
